evidence.title: Clor overview
evidence.locator: Multiplex agents; local and cloud; Mac app
evidence.finding: Browser workspace and macOS app run the official Claude Code and Codex CLIs with the user subscription or API key, across own machines or hosted runners, with review and phone follow-up.

evidence.title: Understand spaces
evidence.finding: A space combines an agent, repository, sandbox, panes and configuration. Separate spaces isolate checkouts/process trees; the runner reconciles intended state.

evidence.title: Parallel agent work
evidence.finding: Separate spaces have independent files/branches. Tabs inside one space share the working tree.

evidence.title: Shared memory
evidence.locator: Search prior work; durable notes; capture
evidence.finding: Memory indexes sessions; wiki notes persist decisions. Capture can be disabled per space.

evidence.title: Teams and permissions
evidence.finding: Teams own collaborative resources with User, billing and admin roles.

evidence.title: Work with your Team
evidence.finding: Admins invite teammates and assign roles; permitted resources are shared.

evidence.title: Manage secrets
evidence.finding: Secrets are referenced by name at runtime; scopes distinguish personal and Team values.

evidence.title: Install Clor
evidence.finding: CLI installs on macOS/Linux; Windows runs inside WSL2 with Docker Desktop integration.

evidence.title: CLI overview
evidence.finding: CLI has singular command groups, logfmt/JSON/JSONL output and API-key profiles with Team context.

evidence.title: Hosted runners
evidence.finding: Managed cloud runner creation has readiness state; destruction permanently removes the runner.

evidence.title: GitHub integration
evidence.finding: Connected GitHub supports repositories, pull requests and Git authentication; clor webgit serve opens repository work.

evidence.title: Private Docker
evidence.finding: Private Docker requires privileged outer containers, has per-space volumes retained across stop/recreate and documented degraded resource enforcement. It is not hostile-workload isolation.

evidence.title: Execution boundary
evidence.finding: Sandbox adds container isolation; a space without sandbox runs on the host.

evidence.title: Clor pricing
evidence.finding: No subscription; free control plane, unlimited Teams/spaces/configurations. Prepaid credits fund paid services; hosted runners $0.30–$4.95 per started hour.

evidence.title: Clor privacy policy
evidence.finding: Processes service inputs/outputs; does not train on work; primary store US; secrets encrypted, API secrets hashed; deletion request within 30 days with legal retention exceptions.
